question: What Are the Types of Boiler Drum Level Control?
body_html:
Boiler drum level control comes in three types: single element, two element and three element. Each adds a measurement to handle load changes and the shrink and swell effect better.

TypeInputs UsedBest For
Single elementDrum level onlySingle boiler, stable load
Two elementLevel plus steam flow feedforwardSteady feedwater pressure
Three elementLevel, steam flow, feedwater flowVarying loads and feedwater pressure
